reviews.comment: Be prepared to teach yourself. She doesn't lecture in class, rather, you have to watch her demo videos that don't really align with the projects. Cancels class once a week, which is fine, but would rather have 2 classes where she actually lectures and walks through in-class examples, like other data analytics courses taught at A&M.

Class is basically a procrastinators worst nightmare. Waiting till the last moment to make your excel will be a bad night. 3 big projects are used for tests which are majority of the grade. The TAs would constantly mislead me so be careful of that. Class itself isn't that hard, but if you delay working on the project, you'll have a rough time

I had a really poor experience with her. She had good teaching skills but clearly did not care about her students. I ran into an issue and needed and asked for help and it took days for her to answer. Then I was rudely lectured that I was making her job harder. I always treated her with respect and wasn't given any and I felt that from day one.
